import zipfile, os, shutil

wheel = '/usr/local/lib/python3.13/ensurepip/_bundled/pip-24.3.1-py3-none-any.whl'
dest = '/usr/local/lib/python3.13/site-packages/'

with zipfile.ZipFile(wheel, 'r') as zf:
    for name in zf.namelist():
        if name.startswith('pip/') and not name.endswith('/'):
            zf.extract(name, dest)
            print(f'Extracted: {name}')
        elif name.startswith('pip/') and name.endswith('/'):
            d = os.path.join(dest, name)
            os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
            print(f'Mkdir: {name}')

print('Done')
" 2>&1
